newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media to July 27.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media to July 27.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to July 27, 1997
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
MONDAY, JUNE 30

LUXEMBOURG - EU culture ministers meet. Provisional agenda includes amendments to the "Television without Trontiers" directive on cross-border broadcasting, proposed fund for EU audiovisual producers, cooperation between public broadcast corporations, decision on European Cultural Cities.
JULY
FRIDAY, JULY 2

LONDON - Sports & Television: New Values and Opportunities. The Second European Strategy Summit on Television Sports Rights, featuring 32 speakers in sports television broadcasting, rights and programming. Hyatt Carlton Hotel, London. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700 or email liz_burns@ibcuklon.cccmail.compuserve.com (two-day conference, July 2-3)
LONDON - Advertising & Marketing to Children. Conference on how children and their mothers spend their money; what's in and what's not, new product development. Contact: (44) 1932 771161
THURSDAY, JULY 3

LONDON - Sports & Television: New Values and Opportunities. The Second European Strategy Summit on Television Sports Rights, featuring 32 speakers in sports television broadcasting, rights and programming. Hyatt Carlton Hotel, London.
(two-day conference, July 2-3)

LONDON - NetMedia 97: Where the Media Meet the Internet. Organised by the Department of Journalism, City University, conference examines how journalists and media organisations shape up in the digital age and examines promises and pitfalls of emerging communication technologies. Contact: (44) 171 412 7470 (two-day conference, July 3-4).
LONDON - Targeting the Youth Market. Conference on youth culture and new methods of reaching and rebuilding relationships with the youth market. Contact: (44) 1932 771161

Includes how to identify potential sponsors, prepare sponsorship bids, understand what sponsors want from the relationship, what to do when things go wrong and you find yourself going into receivership.
